field_changes.old: Your interval timer now stays in sync between your phone and Apple Watch during Traditional workouts — start it on either device and the other mirrors it instantly. The solo contest leaderboard is now a clean ranked list showing rank, name, and points. New Adaptive Plan members can pick their training days by day of the week, with workout reminders at 5 PM. Plus a few bug fixes and visual polish.
field_changes.new: Periodization is now fully live on iOS! Upgrade to Elite or set a routine as your current plan and you'll be walked through a personalized setup — including an equipment check and a "Week 1 is ready" confirmation so you can dive in with confidence. Load progression is smarter too: for assisted exercises, the app now correctly understands that less resistance means harder, keeping your weight targets right on track.
